title: THE ONE SHOT: BATALHA DE COMÉDIA
desc: Eight of Japan's top comedians selected by Daigo, including M-1 finalists and King of Conte champions, must each write and direct a short film with just one rule: include a single, hilarious gag. In this unprecedented competition, skilled comedians have just "one shot" to prove their true talent.
